# Official UPN QR examples

The QR codes printed in the ZBS standard "UPN QR – tehnični standard", verzija 1.1, november 2016
(`priloga7.1.-UPN QR tehnicni standard_ver1_1_november2016.pdf` in `objava_dokumentacije_UPN_QR-2016-12-15.zip`,
published at https://www.zbs-giz.si/standardi-in-prirocniki/), extracted from the PDF with a white quiet zone added.
`payloads.json` holds the text each code contains, exactly (the examples pad the optional reserve with spaces).

| File | Example in the standard (Priloga 1) |
|---|---|
| `example-cover.png` | Cover page and figures 3–4: a bill from Snaga d.o.o. |
| `example-a.png` | A – payment order, cash |
| `example-b.png` | B – payment order, non-cash |
| `example-c.png` | C – payment order of a registered issuer |
| `example-d.png` | D – registered issuer, charity (no payer, no amount) |
| `example-e.png` | E – cash deposit (polog) |
| `example-f.png` | F – cash withdrawal (dvig) |
| `example-g.png` | G – cross-border payment with RF references |
| `example-h.png` | H – registered issuer with an RF reference |
| `example-g-photo.jpg` | Example G, scaled down, rotated and saved as JPEG, to stand in for a photo |

The names, addresses and account numbers are the standard's own sample data.
